mainText:
Good afternoon. Weather in Prishtina: 21 degrees now, scattered clouds. Next 24 hours: high 19, low 5.

Ukraine continues to fortify its border with Belarus, with high levels of engineering work, said Andrii Demchenko.

The United States Department of Homeland Security reported a historic record of bans and arrests for the fiscal year 2026, surpassing previous highs.

Manchester United has officially appointed Argentine coach Mauricio Pochettino as its new manager, succeeding Michael Carrick.

Kosovo customs officials uncovered 150,000 euros hidden in a vehicle during a checkpoint inspection at the Vermeja border crossing.

Pristina's Directorate for Security and Emergencies warned residents to take extra precautions as strong winds are expected to intensify later today and into the evening.
